/033-wintercamp2027.desc: Event Details HUBERT EATON SCOUT RESERVATION CUB SCOUT WINTER CAMP AT HUBERT EATON SCOUT RESERVATION: Join us for an exciting Winter Camp at the beautiful Hubert Eaton Scout Reservation, where Cub Scouts can embrace the magic of the season! This thrilling outdoor adventure offers a perfect blend of fun, learning, and friendship, designed for Scouts of all ages. Campers will participate in a variety of winter-themed activities. Each day is filled with games and challenges that encourage teamwork and exploration of the great outdoors. Scouts will also have the opportunity to learn about wildlife in winter and the importance of conservation. With cozy campfires, hot cocoa, and evening activities, including storytelling and stargazing, there’s plenty of time to make lasting memories with new friends. Our experienced leaders ensure a safe, supportive environment for all participants. Pack your winter gear and prepare for an unforgettable experience at Hubert Eaton Scout Reservation, where adventure awaits in the snowy wilderness! Siblings during cub scout weekends must be age 5 and up . SCOUTS BSA WINTER CAMP AT HUBERT EATON SCOUT RESERVATION: Gear up for an incredible Winter Camp at Hubert Eaton Scout Reservation, where adventure meets the beauty of winter! This immersive experience is designed for Scouts BSA members, offering a unique opportunity to enhance skills, forge friendships, and enjoy the great outdoors. Participants will engage in a wide range of winter activities. Scouts will also have the chance to earn merit badge. Our experienced staff will guide activities that emphasize safety, teamwork, and personal growth.
